spans.s: --a son of सर्वरी and दोष; an अम्श of Hari. भा.
(I)--a son of माद्री and कृष्ण. भा. X. ६१. १५.
(II)--a palace in the form of a lion; the तोरण is १६ hastas. M. २६९. ३६, ४९.

--born of Hari and Pulaha; as a son of जाम्- बवान्, a वानर जाति;
1: Br.

. ५०.
a golden image of, as a gift for वीरव्रतम् of women;
2: M. १०१. २८.
the riding animal of ललिता;
3: Br. III. ३५. ३८; ५१. १०; IV. १७. 8; २९. ४१.
born out of the wrath of शिव and destroyed दक्ष's sacrifice.
4: वा. १०१. २९५.
--a son and commander of भण्ड. Br. IV. २१. ८१; २६. ४८.
--the lion-gate in front of शिवलोक. Br. III. ३२. ११.
--the chariot of lion of कार्त्तिकेय. वा. ४१. ३८.
--When Guru is in Simha (this only once in every twelve years) गयाश्राद्धम् not to be omitted. वा. १०५. १९.

(I)--a daughter of Diti and कश्यप and sister of हिरण्यकशिपु: the wife of Vipracitti, and mother of one hundred and one sons of whom राहु was the eldest;
1: भा. V. २४. 1;

(II)--a daughter of दक्ष;
1: M. १७१. २९.
a goddess enshrin- ed at कृतशौच.
2: Ib. १३. ४५.
[page३-604+ ३३]
--one of the सम्स्कारस् enjoined on a द्विज। Vi. III. १३. 6.
